notes.title: Day-1 Patch
notes.content:
Hello there!

I've just released a small patch with the following changes:
[list]
[*] Added option to restart a level
[*] Mouse cursor hidden during gameplay
[*] Added security question before saying "no" to a continue or restarting
[*] Fixed some minor collision issues
[*] Increased three star time for level 3
[/list]
